select
    cast(CURRENCYID as varchar) as currency_id,
    cast(EXCHANGE_RATE_TO_BASE as decimal(38, 12)) as exchange_rate_to_base
from read_csv_auto(
    '../data/dim_currency.csv',
    delim = ';',
    header = true
)

select
    cast(regexp_extract(GAMEID, '[0-9]+') as bigint) as game_id,
    cast(GAMETYPE as varchar) as game_type,
    regexp_extract_all(cast(THEMES as varchar), 'THEME_[0-9]+') as themes,
    regexp_extract_all(cast(MECHANICS as varchar), 'MECH_[0-9]+') as mechanics
from read_csv_auto(
    '../data/dim_game.csv',
    delim = ';',
    header = true,
    quote = '"',
    strict_mode = false
)

select
    cast(DATE as date) as activity_date,
    cast(regexp_extract(CASINOID, '[0-9]+') as bigint) as casino_id,
    cast(regexp_extract(PLAYERID, '[0-9]+') as bigint) as player_id,
    cast(regexp_extract(GAMEID, '[0-9]+') as bigint) as game_id,
    cast(CURRENCYID as varchar) as currency_id,
    cast(TOTALWAGER as decimal(38, 12)) as total_wager,
    cast(TOTALPAYOUT as decimal(38, 12)) as total_payout,
    cast(TOTALSPINS as bigint) as total_spins,
    cast(GOLIVE_DATE as date) as go_live_date
from read_csv_auto(
    '../data/fact_activity.csv',
    delim = ';',
    header = true
)

select currency_id
from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_currency"
where currency_id is null

select exchange_rate_to_base
from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_currency"
where exchange_rate_to_base is null

select
    currency_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_currency"
where currency_id is not null
group by currency_id
having count(*) > 1

select game_id
from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_game"
where game_id is null

select game_type
from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_game"
where game_type is null

select
    game_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_game"
where game_id is not null
group by game_id
having count(*) > 1

from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_fact_activity"

from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_fact_activity"

from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_fact_activity"

where player_id is null

    currency_id,

select distinct
    game_id,
    unnest(mechanics) as mechanic
from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_game"
where len(mechanics) > 0

select distinct
    game_id,
    unnest(themes) as theme
from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_dim_game"
where len(themes) > 0

select game_id
from "adp_assessment"."main"."bridge_game_mechanics"
where game_id is null

select game_id
from "adp_assessment"."main"."bridge_game_themes"
where game_id is null

select mechanic
from "adp_assessment"."main"."bridge_game_mechanics"
where mechanic is null

with child as (
    select currency_id as from_field
    from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_fact_activity"
    where currency_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select currency_id as to_field
    from "adp_assessment"."main"."dim_currency"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

where theme is null

select
    activity.activity_date,
    activity.casino_id,
    activity.player_id,
    activity.game_id,
    game.game_type,
    activity.total_wager * currency.exchange_rate_to_base as total_wager_base,
    activity.total_payout * currency.exchange_rate_to_base as total_payout_base,
    (activity.total_wager - activity.total_payout)
        * currency.exchange_rate_to_base as revenue,
    activity.total_spins,
    activity.go_live_date,
    game.* exclude (game_id, game_type)
from "adp_assessment"."main"."stg_fact_activity" as activity
inner join "adp_assessment"."main"."dim_currency" as currency
    on activity.currency_id = currency.currency_id
inner join "adp_assessment"."main"."dim_game" as game
    on activity.game_id = game.game_id
